question: 'Long Walk to Freedom' is an autobiography of ____________.
solution: The correct answer is __**Nelson Mandela.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **'Long Walk to Freedom' is an autobiography of Nelson Mandela, who was a South African anti-apartheid revolutionary and politician.**
